text: Quite literally live free or die 😂

USA requires car makers to safety engineer the cars for unbelted occupants also as a bare minimum which means that the amount of testing and monies that goes to be able to make a road legal cars for the US is significantly higher
So occupant protection is very very difficult to achieve for US vehicles

On the flipside - EU has laws for safety engineering the cars for pedestrian protection i.e. Deployable bonnet airbags and other several systems... US was going to get the same laws as there is nothing for pedestrian protection in an accident but Trump came in and said Dont Want so... No pedestrian protection laws in the US
